name: Drupical
description: Displays Drupal community events from drupal.org.

suggests.drupal/dashboard: Centralized admin dashboard the Events Feed block integrates with (used in Drupal CMS).

project_description:
This project is about the Drupical.com calendar/map tool and also for a Drupal block which shows the latest events for your own website.

 Drupical.com lists worldwide Drupal events in a useful and nice way.

 drupical.com 

 
We aggregate events from Drupal Community Events , add some infos, like the location (GEO Data), link, logo etc. and display them nicely laid out on a world map. If your event is missing, simply create it over at Drupal Groups Event - to have it listed also on drupical.com.

 
 You want to show your users also Drupal events on your website? 

Install the latest version of the Module and show your website users the broad variety of Drupal event.
